rationale: The agent canceled the order without first confirming with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm any order-changing action before taking it. It also did not first answer whether the camera was 10x zoom, nor attempt to modify the item to 10x zoom as requested. There is no clear evidence it verified 10x zoom availability or price to select the correct cancellation reason; it used “no longer needed” without justification. Additionally, it stated refund timing (5–7 business days) without tool-backed evidence. While the agent did look up a user by email and fetched order details, it did not clearly link ownership or authenticate beyond that. These issues mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
